EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed the works of supply & erection/retrofitting/upgradation of microprocessor based Electro Static Precipitator controllers in coal fired Thermal Power Station of capacity 210MW or above, for an amount not less than Rs. 62 Lakhs ( without GST) in the preceding Five financial years ( 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). As a proof, the bidder shall furnish single or multiple work order(not more than 3) along with corresponding work done certificate and performance certificate for having served for at least 2 years issued by an Officer not below the rank of Chief Engineer/Competent authority.

The bidder should be an OEM/OES of ESP controllers who has carried out supply & erection of microprocessor based Electro Static Precipitator controllers in coal fired Thermal Power Station of capacity 210MW or above in India. As a Proof, the bidder shall furnish Company Registration certificate or OEM authorization certificate along with relevant documents.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: RTPS - Retrofitting of 24 Nos. of PRECICON-II(S) controllers with the latest version of microprocessor controllers in ESP system of Unit-2

itemList.description: Microprocessor based latest advanced version ESP Controllers with all accessories for retrofitting in places of existing ICE-C version controllers. (Furnish the detailed specifications of the offered product)

Retrofit kit for conversion of existing TR control panels to suit new version- consists of all components to make the system complete in all respects like
components required in EC panels & HVRTs along with required accessories in order to complete the system. (Furnish the detailed specifications of the offered product)

Retrofitting of new ESP controllers, using retrofitting kit-components, in place of existing old controllers in existing ESP panels. Testing of retrofit field
controllers and final commissioning of new retrofit controller panels.along with required accessories in order to complete the system.
